caseName: American Trucking Associations v. United States

opinions.text:
Appeals from the United States District Court for the District of Columbia Circuit. (Probable jurisdiction noted, 352 U. S. 816.) The motion for leave to file brief of National Industrial Traffic League, as amicus curiae, is granted.

Reported below: 144 F. Supp. 365.
